title: Extension by zero of complexes preserves colimits
statement: Let C be a category with zero object and zero morphisms, and let e be an embedding of complex shapes c into c′. For a category J such that C has colimits of shape J, extension of C-valued complexes along e by zero preserves colimits of shape J. In degrees in the range this extension is evaluation at the preimage; in the remaining degrees it is zero. This includes the empty colimit.

source.place: Degreewise colimits of complexes; extension by zero from Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/Embedding/Extend.lean. Existing project proof moved unchanged from ProEtaleModuleCohomologyCoproducts.

proof.text: Evaluate the extended complex in a degree in the embedding range. The canonical extension component isomorphisms identify this composite functor with evaluation at the preimage degree. Evaluation preserves colimits of complexes, which are computed degreewise.

Outside the embedding range the evaluated extension functor is zero, hence preserves colimits. Degreewise detection of colimit cocones now proves the claim for extension itself, including empty diagrams.
